Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a hallucination in its analysis of the WebSurfer's results. The WebSurfer correctly extracted that "Kelly Osbourne" was the host from the Wikipedia snippet, but the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Ed Sheeran" was the host. Ed Sheeran is indeed a British singer-songwriter, but he did not host the 16th Annual Young Hollywood Awards; Kelly Osbourne did. The Planner fabricated this fact without any basis in the provided search results.
